title: New albums out today: Snoh Aalegra, Offset, Becky Hill and more
summary: It is a busy release day, with new records from the US and the UK.
body:
Today is one of the busiest album release days of the autumn, with new records across R&B, hip-hop and pop.

From the United States

  • Snoh Aalegra returns with Legendary Love, picked by NPR Music as one of the best albums of the week.
  • Offset has released his fourth solo album, which had been delayed from October.
  • Wiz Khalifa's Cool is his first album under a new record deal.

From the United Kingdom

  • Becky Hill has released REBECCA, her third album.
  • Jake Bugg is back with Alamo.

U2's Carnaval de Luz is also out today.

Sources: NPR Music, HotNewHipHop.
